newsitem.title: ITALY: Montepaschi mulls buying San Paolo stake.
newsitem.headline: Montepaschi mulls buying San Paolo stake.

text.p: The director general of Italian banking group Monte dei Paschi di Siena has been given an "exploratory mandate" by the bank's board to study the possible purchase of a stake in San Paolo bank, a Paschi source said.
The source could not, however, confirm whether or not the stake would be between three and five percent as mentioned by political sources.

"The stake hasn't been set, neither has the price been discussed. Director general Divo Gronchi will refer back to the next board meeting about the results of the exploratory sounding out in order to come up with an offer," the Paschi source said.
Also at today's board meeting, Montepaschi chairman Giovanni Grottanelli De' Santi tendered his resignation in order to take up the chairmanship of the bank's foundation.
